name: Riverside Plaza
summary: Cheerful, classy retail center with a supermarket, specialty stores & casual dining, plus a cinema.
description: Galleria at Tyler is Riverside's premier indoor shopping destination, offering an extensive selection of retail, dining, and entertainment options. The center provides a climate-controlled shopping experience with a diverse mix of national retailers and local favorites, serving the Inland Empire community.
demographics: The Galleria at Tyler serves the Riverside and broader Inland Empire market, attracting middle-income families and younger demographics with household incomes ranging from $50,000 to $90,000. The trade area comprises suburban families, young professionals, and college students from nearby UC Riverside, seeking convenient access to mainstream retail and dining options. Shoppers typically prioritize value and convenience, with strong weekday evening and weekend traffic patterns reflecting the working-class family composition of the region.
